title: College Enrollment
scope: This ledger ranks states on NCES Digest fall enrollment in degree-granting postsecondary institutions for 2022, and also reports 2023 SAT mean scores by state, public FTE faculty and staff and students-per-faculty for Fall 2023 (Digest 314.50), IPEDS 6-year bachelor's graduation rates by state for the 2017 cohort, bachelor's degrees conferred in 2020-21, degree-granting institution counts for 2022-23, public 4-year in-state tuition and fees for 2022-23, and public higher-education appropriations and expenditures for 2020-21. National full-time faculty composition (rank and sex) remains on Digest 315.20.
exclusions: Does not cover K-12, rankings of individual colleges as advice, or predictions of admission. ACT state means are not in the current Digest xlsx set.
heritage: Formerly Higher Education College Admissions, Enrollment, Faculty and Staff, and Student Data
vintage_note: Rebuilt Aug 15, 2026 from NCES Digest 2023 table 304.10, Fall 2022 total enrollment.  Later views compiled Aug 15, 2026 are stored under derived.secondary. Later views compiled Aug 15, 2026 are stored under derived.secondary. Tableau companions compiled Aug 16, 2026 are stored under derived.secondary.

q: Fall college enrollment, SAT scores, faculty and staff, graduation, tuition, and higher-education finance by state.
lead: Fall enrollment in degree-granting postsecondary institutions was 18,580,026 in 2022 (SRC-608-01). Massachusetts enrolled 468,960, rank 12 of 51 (derived, SRC-608-01). The SAT mean total score for 2023 graduates was 1028 in the United States, with 51.2% of graduates taking the test (SRC-608-02). Massachusetts scored 1112 (57.0% taking the test) (SRC-608-02). Degree-granting institutions employed 1,530,513 faculty in Fall 2023 (SRC-608-03). The IPEDS 6-year bachelor's graduation rate for the 2017 entry cohort was 64.5% nationally; Massachusetts was 75.0%, rank 2 of 51 (derived, SRC-608-12). Public institutions employed 11,022 FTE faculty in Massachusetts in Fall 2023, rank 24 of 51 (derived, SRC-608-06). Public 4-year in-state tuition and fees were $14,345 in Massachusetts in 2022-23 (SRC-608-09). Full-time faculty numbered 859,825 in Fall 2023; 192,300 were professors and 48.8% were women (SRC-608-05).

ipeds_6yr_grad_by_state_2017.note: IPEDS GR2023 joined to HD2023 on UNITID. Bachelor's or equivalent subcohort at degree-granting 4-year institutions: completers within 150% of normal time (GRTYPE 12) divided by the adjusted cohort (GRTYPE 8). The national rollup is 64.5 percent, matching Digest 326.10.
